modernfix_pack_cache_prebuild.conversion: @Inject TAIL on ResourcePackLoader.loadResourcePacks(PackRepository, Function): one background task per jar-backed mod-file pack builds a ModernFix PackResourcesCacheEngine as ModernFix does (same constructor, root paths from the mod file's findResource, awaitLoad via hasResource); nothing is stored in the pack. MixinExtras @WrapOperation (priority 1500, require = 0, expect = 0; targets generateResourceCache and Forge's toString, see the guard note) on the NEW PackResourcesCacheEngine inside ModernFix's generateResourceCache (merged into Forge's PathPackResources): hands over the finished engine (waits while building; ModernFix builds in place when the task never started or failed). Finished engines are kept per mod file and handed to the packs later loads make for the same file. Helper bons.furious.patch.modernfix_pack_prebuild.PackCachePrebuild. Shadow mode -Dbons_and_furious.modernfixPackCachePrebuild.shadow=true.
